taskResults.reason: The official Actinver app listing uses a standalone white A and gold dot on a dark blue field, but no original vector of that standalone emblem was found. Wikimedia preserves an SVG attributed to Actinver's former official URL, but it is a complete wordmark, not a suitable standalone square-cell emblem. The old official SVG URL returned HTTP 404. The app artwork is PNG and is not an eligible vector source; no tracing or reconstructed artwork was used.
